title: Hey everyone.
content: So I’m pregnant and recently my dreams have all been lucid. I had a dream last night that I was in a building… maybe a hospital? But it turned into an office when I walked through one door.. soon I was in a random neighborhood after some walking. I was so confused. But anyway I found a house that was huge and that just turned into a park. I’m not too sure what’s going on but I was just wondering if anyone else has experienced that? The apartments were colorful but also dull. The complex had lots of sidewalk and street for cars. A lot of trees and only one spot with mailboxes. The park was just a field and there was sidewalk. The office had a lot of women and men sitting at their desks with computers in cubicles. As for the hospital it was like I was in a waiting room?.. not too sure on that one.
